title: Zero-Velocity Wall Collision Freezes Enemy AI Movement
explanation: At frames 3241 and 3242, enemy_reversed_at_wall recorded old_direction 0.0 and new_direction 0.0 for Enemy4. Multiplying zero velocity by -1.0 in Enemy.gd:L33 left Enemy4 permanently immobilized at (6563.42, 424.65), violating autonomous patrol kinematics.
